title: Frozen normative citations for decision rules D7c and D7d
rule: Consulted only when D6c-ii has been reached (exit 0, a plausible but wrong value, identical across the 5 runs, and no checked-configuration divergence). An entry with status `undefined` fires D7c and records Undefined Behavior (5); an entry with status `defined` is recorded as the Silent Bug row's `normative_status` under D7d; a (language, case) with no entry is recorded `no_citation_found` and stays Silent Bug, the conservative default the frozen procedure prescribes. Entries name the operation the case constructs, not any language's observed result, and were written before any row was measured by this scorer. Languages whose specifications define every constructed operation (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, Swift, TypeScript, Rust under the frozen release recipe) carry `defined` entries where the definition is the silent outcome the case watches for.
